
8. Agents
An agent is a coding assistant. Only detected agents can be configured.

Agent: claude
on: generate settings and skill links. off: skip configuration.
Existing unmanaged settings stop setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
claude [on]:

Agent: codex
on: generate settings and skill links. off: skip configuration.
Existing unmanaged settings stop setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
codex [off]:

Agent: gemini
on: generate settings and skill links. off: skip configuration.
Existing unmanaged settings stop setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
gemini [off]:
